title: Woven cloth from a weave draft
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of woven fabric from a weave draft: plain, 2/2 and 3/1 twill, 4/1 satin, basket or herringbone, with round threads, twist, fuzz, slubs and gaps. Use for clothing, upholstery, sacks, canvas and banners.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python woven_cloth.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: weave
parameters.meaning: Draft: 0 plain, 1 2/2 twill, 2 3/1 twill, 3 4/1 satin, 4 2/2 basket, 5 herringbone twill.

parameters.name: threads
parameters.meaning: Warp and weft threads across the tile (rounded up to a multiple of the draft size).

parameters.name: thread_width
parameters.meaning: Thread width as a share of the thread spacing; lower values open gaps between threads.

parameters.name: twist
parameters.meaning: Depth of the diagonal twist striations along each thread.

parameters.name: fuzz
parameters.meaning: Loose fibre noise on the thread surface.

parameters.name: slubs
parameters.meaning: Irregular thick and thin stretches and colour changes along the threads.

parameters.name: sheen
parameters.meaning: Lowers roughness on long floats, as in satin.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Natural linen in plain weave with slubs.

presets.name: denim
presets.description: Indigo warp and white weft in 3/1 twill.

presets.name: wool_twill
presets.description: Charcoal and grey wool in 2/2 twill with soft fuzz.

presets.name: satin
presets.description: Burgundy 4/1 satin with long glossy floats.

presets.name: burlap
presets.description: Coarse open jute in plain weave with gaps and hairy fibres.

presets.name: herringbone
presets.description: Brown and cream wool herringbone twill.

limits: Threads are idealized round strands on a regular grid with no fabric drape, stretch or pile. Thread counts are rounded up to a multiple of the draft size. Sheen is approximated by lower roughness on floats; anisotropic highlights need an engine-side fabric shader. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Weave drafts (binary interlacing matrices) for plain, twill, satin, basket and herringbone weaves
Round thread cross-sections with dips at interlacing points
Per-thread hashing for colour and slub variation
Value noise for thick and thin stretches
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
